Product Features

  • Luxurious design: The high-gloss finish combined with gold trim elements ensures clean lines and gives your living room an elegant ambience. The piece of furniture fits in with various interior styles, including modern and Italian.
  • Generous storage space: Four drawers and two cabinet doors provide clear storage space for receivers, remote controls, books and more, keeping your work surface free.
  • Robust and easy to maintain: Made of medium-density fibreboard (MDF) with a high-gloss finish, this piece of furniture is scratch-resistant and durable. A damp cloth is enough to make it look like new.
  • Versatile: The piece of furniture can be used as a TV stand or storage cabinet, flexibly meeting the storage and decoration needs of different rooms.
  • Easy and convenient installation: Includes accessories, detailed assembly instructions and diagrams. Installation is easily possible by one person without additional tools.

Descriptions

Long Description:

Elegant and minimalist, this luxury TV stand boasts a high-gloss finish and gold accents, exuding elegance and style. Four drawers and two doors provide plenty of storage space for set-top boxes, remote controls, books and more, keeping your screen organized. Made of medium-density fiberboard with a high-gloss finish, the TV stand is scratch-resistant, durable, and easy to clean. Whether your living room is modern or Italian-style, this TV stand blends in perfectly and becomes an eye-catcher. Thanks to the ease of installation and the included mounting material, it is a stylish and practical choice for your home.
